map.h5allin:3.guards.5.3.0.message:
Entry from Dargem's diary: "We finally made it to the surface. Out of habit, I was about to tie a handkerchief over my eyes so I wouldn't get blinded, but Deyja's sun was barely breaking through a thick sheet of gray clouds. It was much brighter in the torchlit dungeons than under that sickly-colored sky.

Is that how they live here? I mean, not all necromancers and death knights are undead; some are still living creatures! Back when I dwelt in Nighon, I liked to go out to the surface every now and then, touch the grass, smile at the sun. This place, however... looks like staying in caves would be a lot better for one's peace of mind than going outside. It's all the same for Gunnar—he doesn't think much anyway, and he's plastered all the time these days, unable to come to terms with himself about his failure. But what about me? What can I do to sort out the disorder in my soul?"
map.h5allin:3.guards.6.38.0.message: Entry from Dargem's diary: "The strangest things are going on here! I can smell heavy stench of burning oil, and ahead of me, there loom buildings that look like golem factories; I've seen those in Bracada. Have necromancers started mass-producing golems too, or something? Of course, I've heard of such creatures made of bones and dead flesh, but there never used to be more than a handful of them in the world, mostly museum exhibits. Why do that if you can just make a corpse walk as it is? I don't know what this place is or what is going on here!"
map.h5allin:3.guards.9.10.1.message: This might come in handy in a fight against Nagash!
map.h5allin:3.header.description: To win, Dargem must capture the Doom Castle. The heroes' level is limited to 32. After winning, Dargem will proceed to the final scenario of the campaign, retaining all of his skills and spells.
map.h5allin:3.header.name: Knee-Deep In The Undead
map.h5allin:3.header.rumor.0.text: They say Kastore is so much into mechanisms now, he gave up necromancy for good!
map.h5allin:3.header.rumor.1.text: Maximus became the leader of the goblins and orcs who remained in Deyja.
map.h5allin:3.header.rumor.2.text: Deyjan goblins have prettier women than elves do! Did you know that?
map.h5allin:3.header.rumor.3.text: Can you imagine minotaurs flying? That's crazy talk!
map.h5allin:3.heroes.150.biography: Maximus is one of Kastore's closest associates, a strong and fierce warrior. He is in charge of the necromancer country's defenses while Kastore is away.
map.h5allin:3.heroes.150.name: Maximus
map.h5allin:3.monster.4.68.1.message: "Hey man, might you have any use for a few trusty barrels? Nothing works better for drilling holes in rotten skulls!"
map.h5allin:3.monster.44.31.0.message: The Ayssids are grateful for your help.
map.h5allin:3.monster.51.68.0.message: "We won't be serving necromancers, but we don't mind joining you!"
map.h5allin:3.monster.52.67.0.message: "We appreciate your help! We really weren't keen on turning into walking corpses!"
map.h5allin:3.monster.6.68.1.message: "Crusading is costly business, good sir! Cover our expenses, and we'll be willing to go with you and vanquish the evil spirits."
map.h5allin:3.quest.2.4.0.completed: The vampire is happy to see his kin and offers to let me pass.
map.h5allin:3.quest.2.4.0.firstVisit: There's a powerful vampire lurking here. He says that for some reason he lost contact with his kin, and a respected ancient vampire is supposed to have his own pack and retinue. He'll let me through if I help him reconnect with the others.
map.h5allin:3.quest.2.4.0.nextVisit: I need to find five vampires to get through.
map.h5allin:3.quest.2.62.1.completed: You are pure from black magic. You can go through.
map.h5allin:3.quest.2.62.1.firstVisit: Only one who bears the symbol of being free from corruption can pass through here.
map.h5allin:3.quest.2.62.1.nextVisit: You are unclean! You shall not pass!
map.h5allin:3.quest.30.35.0.completed: I brought the Orb near the magic barrier, and it began flickering! This proves my hypothesis! I learned sorcery from Tor Anwyn himself, after all. Should I break the barrier now, or come back later?
map.h5allin:3.quest.30.35.0.firstVisit: To my great regret, the path to the library is blocked by a conjured barrier. I need something that weakens magic... Do I have an idea? It seems that an Orb of Vulnerability should work!
map.h5allin:3.quest.30.35.0.nextVisit: Alas, without the Orb of Vulnerability, the barrier won't budge!
map.h5allin:3.quest.34.20.1.completed: It looks as though the ancient creature is content now. It offers you the services of its cubs.
map.h5allin:3.quest.34.20.1.firstVisit: A powerful ancient dragon seeks the four elemental spheres. He promises to handsomely reward whoever brings him these artifacts.
map.h5allin:3.quest.34.20.1.nextVisit: The dragon is raging: he wants the complete set of four spheres!
map.h5allin:3.quest.54.36.1.completed: You have completed the task, and the grateful warlock is willing to give you a few Black Dragons.
map.h5allin:3.quest.54.36.1.firstVisit: This powerful warlock is looking for a legendary spell book. He believes that the necromancers have a copy of this compendium, and is ready to reward anyone who delivers him the valuable tome.
map.h5allin:3.quest.54.36.1.nextVisit: The owner of the house advises you to look for the book in the mountains to the west.
map.h5allin:3.quest.55.25.0.completed: "Lady Thunar, at last! We are glad to be traveling with you again."
map.h5allin:3.quest.55.25.0.firstVisit:
There is a large group of elementals hiding in this dead forest.
"Our leader, Thunar, is a prisoner of the necromancers. We're afraid we'll end up in their clutches, too, but we can't do anything while the Older One is not here. Free our Lady, humans!"
map.h5allin:3.quest.55.25.0.nextVisit: "Without Thunar, we will not dare to go anywhere."
map.h5allin:3.sign.14.65.0.message: Don't drink here! You'll become a minotaur!
map.h5allin:3.sign.56.44.0.message: William Setag is buried here. A wretch through and through!

map.h5allin:4.event.0.description:
Dargem's diary. Entry 301

"We had a long journey ahead of us. I would never have imagined a nameless archipelago off the coast of Tatalia to be the location of a legendary artifact—but when I finally met her in her tower, Lady Casmetra stated with full confidence that it should be out there. She gave me all the instructions I might need and promised to keep an eye on my progress.

At first, I suspected Casmetra of plotting against me... however, the swampy shores of Tatalia on the horizon suggested that my employer was going to distract the lizardmen so that I could complete my mission unhindered. I shared my thoughts with Casmetra; she just smiled and assured me that my takeaway was absolutely correct."
map.h5allin:4.event.1.description:
Dargem's diary. Entry 302

"Our paths diverged: the sorceress' fleet sailed for the coast of Tatalia, while my own ships headed towards a mysterious archipelago I had never seen on any map. It must have been deliberately kept a secret from prying eyes, and therefore I reckon that information about it was somehow removed from the cartographers' archives—but I cannot even begin to imagine who could possess sufficient means. Suddenly, I felt a gust of icy wind... it was as if a storm had gathered within a split second!

We had a rough time, but the situation remained under control. We were, however, forced to boxhaul, and that maneuver took us far away from the other two ships with my men. Our own ship had taken heavy damage, so we had to immediately moor at the first island we sailed by. What a shame! I can only hope that our other parties will land here as well, and we will be able to join forces.

I went down to the sandy beach at the head of a small group of mercenaries and looked bitterly at the ship. It's going to need extensive repairs! I didn't want to think about it now, though. Burning with impatience, I was about to unravel the scroll Casmetra had given me, instructing me to only read it after getting close to the target. The yellowed parchment bore a map of the dungeon that apparently contained the Horn of the Abyss. By the looks of it, the map had been charted a very long time ago. We took a great deal of papers and scrolls from the necromancers' library, but I couldn't remember this one. However, back then, I didn't really have time to study the loot in earnest. I was confused by the fact that the map bore hardly any markings, except for a couple of obscure icons with captions: 'The Horn should be here' and 'Guardian!!!' Some magic words were also written here; they were supposed to be uttered in order to dispel some illusions. Unfortunately, the illusions weren't marked on the map either—I had to take my chances.

I tucked the map into my belt and sighed. We will have to defeat the Guardian. This will be the first step in... in MY quest for the Horn of the Abyss!"
map.h5allin:4.event.10.description:
Entry from Dargem's diary:

"Am I losing the plot? It feels like a straight-up open house here, rather than a place where one of the greatest artifacts in the world's history is kept in strict secret. I've just heard from the locals that Black Balfour has been stomping around these parts for several weeks now. He is undoubtedly an eminent pirate, but certainly not a connoisseur of rarities; to be honest, he is an uncouth and all-around nasty character. What wind brought him here? And why now? Did that snake Casmetra lure him here too, looking to make sure I wouldn't leave here in one piece and carry the Horn with me?! Well, the bastard should try me! I'll give him such thorough lightning bolt treatment, he'll turn black as a firebrand and finally earn his moniker in full!

Once I've dealt with him, I'll find Casmetra... First, I'm going to rip that stupid glove off her hand—was it meant to astound me, or something?! I'm not a five-year-old; glowing eyes and iron claws don't scare me. Then I'll blow the magic plaster off her face and see how old she really is—for one can't possibly amass such a wealth of treachery and meanness in one's soul over a single lifetime. And then... Then I'll probably get bored of messing with the worthless hag; by then, I'll have the Horn of the Abyss in my hands! I guess I'll just let her go... and watch her fly down, because she'll be going straight off the balcony of that cursed tower of hers that looks so much like a goblin's club.

Horn of the Abyss! I will not allow you to be tainted by the paws of bloodthirsty halfwits and presumptuous fortune-tellers. You will be mine, mine!"
map.h5allin:4.event.2.description:
Dargem's diary. Entry 303

"Casmetra and her witches promised that they would be able to distract the Tatalians from my endeavors, but that's unlikely to last longer than three months. My employer's powers aren't limitless, although I must admit that she made quite the first impression on me... Well, what can you expect from a craven sorceress from Noraston? That she would pull an army of elves and unicorns out of her pocket? I mean... I was tormented for a while by doubts about her identity, but at this point, it doesn't matter at all.

I wish I could have persuaded Gunnar to stay with us, but the horned hulk was too scared to displease his Nighonian masters. The Minotaur and his goons would be of great help now that I have to defeat the Guardian, whoever it is.

It must be said that not a single thing I'm to do here is straightforward! As Casmetra stated, to get to the Guardian, one has to find the keys. And what might they be? I don't know. The only thing we know for a fact is that the keys are somewhere in this archipelago as well. Time to get off the island and start searching."
map.h5allin:4.event.3.description:
Dargem's diary. Entry 306

"I've spent the longest time thinking about who the Guardian could be. Then, the answer came to me, like a revelation. That is undoubtedly an Azure Dragon. Maybe even more than one. Sometimes, these creatures are also called 'ice dragons', although they have little in common with ice, or with any other element. They are astoundingly huge, ferocious, and ancient. No one really knows if they came to be naturally, or if they were the work of some forerunner of Agar from before the Silence. Unlike the innately docile, or at least controllable, creatures that warlocks create with magic and alchemy, Azure Dragons are exceptionally intelligent and willful. Fortunately, they are quite rare, and besides, some knights and mages consider it their duty to slay one, just to put a feather in their hat. Here's a good time to point out that the hunters killed in these endeavors greatly outnumber the actual slain dragons—but there is never a shortage of new madmen. The reputation gained by these Azure Dragons is thus peculiar, so they prefer to settle in places forgotten by the gods; sometimes, without meaning to, they also become guardians of ancient artifacts and other valuable things, just by way of making themselves a lair near one. If you manage to come across a dungeon where no human has set foot in a couple of centuries, then there almost certainly is a monster of that kind waiting for you inside."
map.h5allin:4.event.4.description:
Dargem's diary. Entry 310

"A message came from this... Casmetra. She sparingly describes her first encounter with the Tatalians and reproaches me for progressing slowly. I'm only mildly annoyed by her grievances. Very soon, everyone will be talking about Dargem; I will be lauded on par with some of the most famous mages and collectors of our time. Does the foolish broad really hope I'll just yield the Horn to her?"
map.h5allin:4.event.5.description:
Dargem's diary. Entry 312

"I saw flashes of lightning on the horizon. This isn't just a distant storm—these are traces of a magical battle. Most likely, Casmetra has come to blows with the Tatalians again. It warms my heart to know she's toiling in vain, and it's a special pleasure to imagine her face contorted with anger, but that's no reason to be tardy. It's time to resolutely muster our strength and fight our way into the dungeon."
map.h5allin:4.event.6.description:
Dargem's diary. Entry 320

"The locals at the archipelago confuse me. From what I've seen and heard, counting the fools who come after the Horn of the Abyss seems to be a source of amusement here. I was even told that bets are being placed. Isn't that odd? I've worked my tail off to get information about this place! It felt like very few people should even know of it! So what was that all about? I spent months stomping around stinking, deadly holes... just so some pompous wench could make sure I was as good as my reputation? Maybe Casmetra had even sent someone here before and withheld the critical information of my predecessors' fates from me! Now that she's got me involved, it's not hard to imagine how things went for them... Doesn't matter anymore. Dargem Llywellyn will prove his worth. Even if the witch seeks to swindle me, I will definitely outsmart her."
map.h5allin:4.event.7.description:
Dargem's diary. Entry 322

"Today, a ship approached dangerously close to the archipelago. No idea whether it was a Tatalian or Erathian one. I couldn't see the flag. Maybe just a privateer. Once again, I'm reminded there's no time to waste. If hordes of lizardmen riding on basiliskback land here, running away will be my only option. Should this battle happen, I won't have any allies on my side, even dubious ones like Kilgor and his horde."
map.h5allin:4.event.8.description:
Dargem's diary. Entry 333

"Today I felt the ominous wind blowing again, just like during the storm that very nearly made my expedition keel over! I started sweating bullets and shivering.

It felt as though the sky itself was laughing eerily... and my guesses were confirmed. The Dead God is the old mate of mine, Boyd. The thief and rascal who plotted against me! Last time we met, I just walked away—but I should have tracked this walking carrion down and burned it with lightning!

I raised my head to the sky and exclaimed, 'Hey, bone face! Let's meet and sort things out like men—even if all things masculine you've ever had have long rotted away! I've murdered my share of powerful mages, warriors, and beasts; and I'll gladly kill a mindless dead clown a second time over if I must! Neither you, nor the dragons, nor anything else will stand in my way when I go to claim the Horn of the Abyss!'

A sailor tapped me on the shoulder and asked if I was all right. I was taken aback and even dropped my hat. The sailor picked it up and shoved it into my hands. I grinned and declared that very soon, we would be sending an old rotten scarecrow who overstayed his welcome in this world to the bottom of the sea! My crew met this announcement with an eager cheer."
map.h5allin:4.event.9.description:
Dargem's diary. Entry 304

"I had a thought: it's worth being thrifty with magic here. I need to shake the habit of unleashing powerful spells for the slightest reason, as I always used to do. I don't know when or where I'll be able to find a source to replenish my magic reserves—and if I'm caught with them low at a bad moment, my expedition will end much sooner than I'd like."
map.h5allin:4.guards.1.50.0.message: Am I willing to take the risk?
map.h5allin:4.guards.11.18.0.message: "This town pays tribute to us. You're not welcome here, pirate boy!"
map.h5allin:4.guards.11.55.0.message: Entry from Dargem's diary: "A terrible picture! Both lost caravels are wrecked, and the shore is littered with corpses and broken weapons. I couldn't believe my eyes! My boys slain by wild orcs! Had Gunnar been here with them, he would surely have handled those senseless creatures... Hell, even that dimwit Gruezak would've done some good! He'd suggest they munch on the biggest piece of carrion they'd ever seen, and the savages would've happily joined our cause! Instead, our forces have been slashed down to a third now. I ordered a search of the wreckage... well, and of the corpses, too. Maybe there's something valuable to be found on them—I mean, the lads don't need it anymore."
map.h5allin:4.guards.14.71.0.message:
Entry from Dargem's diary: "And so my adventure continues! No man or thing will prevent me from claiming the Horn of the Abyss for myself! According to legend, the Horn is powerful enough to ensure that I won't have to fear Casmetra or the ones behind her, should it come into my possession. I have no more doubts that she is not who she claims to be, but whatever her true colors are, I will be able to protect my find!

What I'm worried about, though, is this Dead God. Could it be... No. Nonsense. That pile of bones should be thousands of miles away now, and that's if he hasn't already been laid to rest by some priest or paladin."
map.h5allin:4.guards.18.60.0.message: Entry from Dargem's diary: "Loud-mouthed and stupid, harpies usually live in caves, but for some reason these ones have settled here. I don't even know if I have any use for them."
map.h5allin:4.guards.19.18.0.message: Am I willing to take the risk?
map.h5allin:4.guards.20.58.0.message:
Entry from Dargem's diary:

"While exploring the island, we came across a thatched hut. I drew my cutlass and readied an ice beam, just in case someone jumps us—every other creature we meet on this damn island is trying to eat us!

My fears were unfounded. A decrepit, harmless-looking orc shaman tottered out of the hut, cast a purblind gaze at us, and croaked:
'I know why you're here, umie. You want to get into the Dungeon of the Vengeful Serpent.' 
'I sure hope "umie" isn't an insult, or I'll freeze your empty head and crack it open like a rotten pumpkin,' I said. 
'Lay a finger on me, umie, and you'll never know what it takes to get where you want to get!'

I thought the point reasonable, so I let the magic fizzle out and put my blade away. A surprisingly thorough conversation took place between us, and I learned I would have to find eight pendants to enter the Guardian's dungeon. Six of them are hidden in different parts of the island, and I need to be very careful to avoid missing them. One is kept by a pirate, and another is in the possession of some 'dead god.' I didn't like the last one at all! When I asked the shaman what that 'dead god' was, he just cackled ominously. Then he invited me to enter the hut, where he would show me the location of some of the pendants in his magic cauldron."
map.h5allin:4.guards.22.52.0.message:
Entry from Dargem's diary:

"Just as I expected, I got fatally unlucky. We landed on an island inhabited by numerous, dangerous savages. Despite all troubles, however, I'm still a powerful mage—and I don't suppose anyone has ever encountered such might in this armpit of the world. I guess I might show these cannibals a couple of my little tricks. That should be enough for them to learn who's in charge here now!"
map.h5allin:4.guards.27.56.0.message: Entry from Dargem's diary: "Orcs are undoubtedly some of the stupidest creatures in the world. Even among goblins, some are not only fairly intelligent, but also prone to magic. Orcs, however, are completely hopeless dullards! In these remote parts, however, I shouldn't be discriminating. Even they will do. As the Guardian helps himself to their bodies, I will crush it with magic. Sounds like a plan!"
map.h5allin:4.guards.29.42.0.message: Entry from Dargem's diary: "Someone has scrawled on this rock: FEAR THE DEAD GOD. I can't stand imperatives addressed at me! What if I don't care to fear any god, dead or alive? If you're into this kind of thing, you can fear your gods to your heart's delight. Myself, I prefer to be feared!"
map.h5allin:4.guards.29.7.0.message: Am I willing to take the risk?
map.h5allin:4.guards.31.34.0.message: Do I want to take the risk?
map.h5allin:4.guards.38.58.0.message: Am I willing to take the risk?
map.h5allin:4.guards.40.44.0.message: Am I willing to take the risk?
map.h5allin:4.guards.42.11.0.message: Am I willing to take the risk?
map.h5allin:4.guards.42.25.0.message: Entry from Dargem's diary: "I met a bard girl who offered me a drink and an exchange of stories. Per hers, many years ago there was a prison on this archipelago. Languishing in it was a certain Siagum. These days, both the gaol and its inmate are nearly forgotten; who and why captured him is not known. However, it is said one can still meet him if one's curious and lucky enough. This odd story stuck with me. Does it have anything to do with the dungeon? Somehow, I don't think it does."
map.h5allin:4.guards.46.48.0.message: Entry from Dargem's diary: "A surprise: we found an abandoned mercenary camp. It looks as if those who set it up gathered up overnight and left, taking only the essentials. What could possibly frighten these thugs so much? I think I have a hunch. Most likely, there is a creephole leading to the surface from the dungeon where the Azure Dragons live, and every now and then, they come out to catch themselves a dinner that smells a little less musty than their usual prey. Such a creature appearing suddenly before them might well have caused the mercenaries to run for the hills."
map.h5allin:4.guards.5.63.0.message:
Entry from Dargem's diary:

"A tall, one-eyed man assessed the damage. His verdict was that it would take at least a week and a half to fix the smashed board. This delay, unfortunately, cannot be avoided—but we now have time to locate a source of water and some supplies. On top of that, we will have to find two other ships. I can't wait to get my hands on the Horn, of course, but I can't afford to be irresponsible now."
map.h5allin:4.guards.52.5.0.message: Do I want to take the risk?
map.h5allin:4.guards.56.6.1.message: Entry from Dargem's diary: "There were piles of icy salt on the ground—the remains of my predecessors. I could feel the Azure Dragons' breath. The creatures were waiting for me in the darkness of the cave. I must... I must defeat them! This is something worth living for! The goal of my entire existence is the Horn of the Abyss! Now I know what I'd been working towards all these years. What I fought fate for. There is no more fear, only resolve. Inside this cave lies the answer to all questions, the reward for everything I have endured along the way. I am about to get what I deserve. One more step..."
map.h5allin:4.guards.59.60.0.message: Am I willing to take the risk?
map.h5allin:4.guards.65.40.0.message: Do I want to take the risk?
map.h5allin:4.guards.7.44.0.message: Am I willing to take the risk?
map.h5allin:4.guards.71.33.0.message: Am I willing to take the risk?
map.h5allin:4.guards.71.4.0.message: Entry from Dargem's diary: "Per Casmetra's instructions, this is the island. It is surrounded by very rough waters, and the depth increases sharply just a few cubits from the shore, but for some reason the waves have not washed away the sand covering it... I studied the surface of the island carefully and realized that the breath of Azure Dragons has a peculiar effect on the environment: it causes any matter to crystallize. This is not sand, but salt! It seems that the surrounding waters are gradually turning into it; new grains are sticking to the mass, and the island is growing in size slowly. What monstrous power such a transformation must require! However, it should be much easier to transmute the human body into a crystal; it contains much more matter that is already solid. I imagined the process of getting turned into a pillar of salt. I shuddered."
map.h5allin:4.guards.9.28.1.message:
Entry from Dargem's diary:

"It looks like these caves are much more extensive than they seem. The key to success is to choose the right path and avoid wasting time."
map.h5allin:4.header.description: Dargem must find the entrance to the dungeon where the Horn of the Abyss lies and defeat the Guardian within 3 months. To get there, he will have to eliminate Boyd. The hero's level is unlimited.
map.h5allin:4.header.name: Chasing the Dream
map.h5allin:4.heroes.102.biography: The leader of the archipelago's savages had to use more than just strength and ferocity to achieve his position. He also has a smattering of secret shamanic knowledge.
map.h5allin:4.heroes.102.name: Fangtooth
map.h5allin:4.heroes.16.biography: Siagum is the leader of the mysterious Triangle cult. This teaching says: there is no geometric figure more stable and perfect than a triangle; sooner or later all other figures will wane, so everyone must accept the Triangle into their heart.
map.h5allin:4.heroes.16.name: Siagum
map.h5allin:4.heroes.212.name: Balfour
map.h5allin:4.heroes.64.name: Boyd
map.h5allin:4.heroes.95.biography: This minotaur sports a rare coat with a striped back. That's how he got his nickname, Barbus.
map.h5allin:4.heroes.95.name: Barbus
map.h5allin:4.monster.12.56.0.message: "Humies! Today we will be feasting upon fresh, tender humies! Fetch my sharpest cleaver!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.13.23.0.message: "You're in luck! When I put out one of your eyes, you'll still have the other!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.14.67.0.message: "Who are you? We didn't invite you. Get out!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.14.8.0.message: "You boys! Fancy a walk in our statue garden?"
map.h5allin:4.monster.15.39.0.message: "Sir, we are so happy to see you! We barely escaped with our lives from those undead and savages!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.16.41.0.message: I've heard some people call these things "ducks." It seems to me that wyverns have a lot more in common with geese—but I must admit I'm not the greatest ornithologist alive.
map.h5allin:4.monster.17.24.0.message: Chop up some duck necks for dinner...
map.h5allin:4.monster.18.44.0.message: The local mummies are quite dead, but for some reason they still walk. This needs to be fixed.
map.h5allin:4.monster.19.66.0.message: Apparently, these wild behemoths came down from the mountains for snacks. Why won't they just eat each other? That would make the world much more of a peaceful place!
map.h5allin:4.monster.2.4.1.message: This seems to be the dragon the ogre mage complained about.
map.h5allin:4.monster.20.50.0.message: "Yousa small and wimpy! Meesa big and strong!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.21.32.0.message: There must be a reason this pack of bloodthirsty behemoths is here! They must be guarding something more important than a mere quarry!
map.h5allin:4.monster.21.46.0.message: "The shrinesss of our people are khhere!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.24.54.0.message: It seems that these men got lost and became too suspicious.
map.h5allin:4.monster.24.58.0.message: "We gathered here to sing songs and have a round dance—you're bothering us, pirate boy!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.25.47.0.message: "Hey, little wizard, don't you run away! You look entirely too delicious!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.27.22.0.message: "We guard the sacred relics! Get out, you infidels!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.28.63.0.message: Is there anything worse than huge carnivorous dragonflies? Maybe only huge carnivorous bumblebees. It's a good thing they don't exist. Or is it just that no one has ever escaped them alive to tell the tale?..
map.h5allin:4.monster.29.12.0.message: "Hey, you! How would you like getting turned into hedgehogs? Our arrows can do it, no problem!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.29.48.0.message:
These pirates survived by some miracle. They told me how their ship had suddenly become engulfed in a firestorm, and on the shore, there were already hordes of skeletons and other undead, armed to the teeth and waiting for them.

This story sounds suspiciously familiar.
map.h5allin:4.monster.29.59.0.message: "Stupid fish lover! You think you own this island?!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.33.22.0.message: Sinister birds are coming down from the cliffs!
map.h5allin:4.monster.34.55.0.message: I'm getting pretty tired of dragons! However... can a good adventure even be considered complete if you haven't killed at least one of each color?..
map.h5allin:4.monster.35.60.0.message: We're having griffin roast tonight... or maybe the griffin is having a stew of us. Let's see who's hungrier!
map.h5allin:4.monster.37.19.0.message: "We are a horde! What about you?"
map.h5allin:4.monster.4.26.0.message: The harpies... why are there so many harpies on the surface?
map.h5allin:4.monster.4.61.0.message: These monstrous serpents crawled out onto the land to feast on goblins. However, it seems as though humans seem no less appetizing to them.
map.h5allin:4.monster.4.71.1.message: There must be some particularly valuable prisoner being held in this prison. Otherwise, why would there be so many snakes here?
map.h5allin:4.monster.4.8.0.message: It looks like these monsters are guarding some kind of prison.
map.h5allin:4.monster.40.31.0.message: "Fish lovers are here again! Crack their skulls!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.43.70.0.message: "We were summoned to guard this tent! Violators shall be destroyed!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.44.28.0.message: "This dungeon holds priceless secrets! A self-taught pirate mage is not worthy of them!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.45.58.0.message: What could be more unpleasant than an animated stone that thinks it's a dragon? Maybe a chunk of crystal that thinks it's a titan!
map.h5allin:4.monster.49.3.0.message: As I neared the gloomy edifice, I heard a voice exclaim, "Hey, my lord! Save me from the evil spirits; they won't let me get out of here! I am a seasoned sailor and will help you in your endeavors!". It sounded familiar. Just as I was about to ask what the evil spirits were, they manifested on their own.
map.h5allin:4.monster.5.15.0.message: "We shall sacrifice you to the Dead God!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.5.4.0.message: As soon as we came out of the portal, huge animated statues came barreling down at us!
map.h5allin:4.monster.53.42.0.message: Even the cobblestones here are ferocious!
map.h5allin:4.monster.57.67.0.message: This place seems to be teeming with all sorts of dragons!
map.h5allin:4.monster.57.8.1.message:
"Even here, there is no peace! We don't care who you are or what you want. The only thing you'll find here is death."

The dragon let out a deafening roar. I felt the vaults of the cave tremble, and a few pebbles fell on my head. The Nighonian boy, who had long faded into my subconscious, screamed out in anguish: 'Get out of here now!!!', but I couldn't back down. Not anymore. The Horn was calling out for me! To flinch now would mean to spit on everything that was still dear to me in this life. In the crackle of the splitting rock, I could hear an unnerving rasp, as if some dry bones were rubbing against each other—and I recognized this noise... I heard it when the dead man enjoyed his fleeting moment of triumph over me, throwing back his empty skull and cackling in ecstasy—but I've now settled my old scores and forced fate to turn its face toward me! I must fight!!!
map.h5allin:4.monster.6.31.0.message: What are the scorpicores doing here? Something must have forced them to leave the caves.
map.h5allin:4.monster.61.56.0.message: "We're not your housekeepers! Feel the wrath of magic!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.63.49.0.message: "This ring is of great value! We won't let you take it!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.64.28.0.message: "Sulfur looks beautiful when it burns! Wanna see?"
map.h5allin:4.monster.66.19.0.message: "Hoom, hoom... we will not let this knackery reopen!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.67.34.1.message: "In the name of the Dead God!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.67.36.0.message: What are these nightmarish creatures from a madman's dreams?!
map.h5allin:4.monster.68.10.0.message: "I inherited a recipe of delectable cutlets from my Granny! It don't call for any salt bar some old salt!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.68.44.0.message: "Hey, sailor, spent too long at sea?"
map.h5allin:4.monster.68.51.0.message: "A little man like you, hero, put out our kinsman's eye! Die!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.7.49.0.message: "We've been hired to guard a secret magic lab! Get out!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.70.41.0.message: These elementals seem to be guarding a sort of prison. I could definitely use some help to look for new mercenaries!
map.h5allin:4.monster.71.61.0.message: "Hey, buddy! You've got a face like... like what you see on a tombstone! Haha!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.72.5.0.message: These monsters appear to be the last obstacle before the Guardian! Soon enough, everyone will hail Dargem, the great mage and owner of the Horn of the Abyss!
map.h5allin:4.monster.72.66.0.message: "We've come to treat ourselves to some fresh brigands! Don't you dare disrupt our diet!"
map.h5allin:4.monster.9.23.0.message: These evil eyes are out in the open. They must have been startled by the Azure Dragon... or something else?
map.h5allin:4.monster.9.63.0.message: "Humies! I'm sick and tired of eating fish—finally, some fresh meat!"
map.h5allin:4.quest.16.52.0.completed: I have everything I need to perform a healing ritual. Shall we get the boys back on their feet?
map.h5allin:4.quest.16.52.0.firstVisit: I ran across some survivors from my party; the men had taken shelter in a hut. Unfortunately, they were all gravely injured and could barely walk. I'm not an Erathian priest, but I know a healing ritual that will bring them to their feet. I just need to find 15 gems.
map.h5allin:4.quest.16.52.0.nextVisit: My men can't be helped without the ritual. We need to find gems.
map.h5allin:4.quest.19.14.0.completed: As soon as the harpies saw their sisters, they started cheering, making the most insufferable noise. Release the harpies and sail through?
map.h5allin:4.quest.19.14.0.firstVisit: The harpies on these rocks will not let me pass. They squeal incessantly about some sisters. Perhaps if I bring their sisters, they'll stop throwing themselves at my sails?
map.h5allin:4.quest.19.14.0.nextVisit: Apparently, I'm doing something wrong. The harpies keep attempting to fly right through my sails.
map.h5allin:4.quest.27.22.0.completed: I think I've got what the pilgrims need. Give up the rings?
map.h5allin:4.quest.27.22.0.firstVisit: Pilgrims are camping here. They say they'll let us pass if we help them find some relics of life.
map.h5allin:4.quest.27.22.0.nextVisit: The pilgrims don't want to bargain—they demand the relics.
map.h5allin:4.quest.31.42.0.completed: The ogre is very happy that he can continue to study magic in peace. As a reward, he wants to give me something that is useless to him.
map.h5allin:4.quest.31.42.0.firstVisit: Here lives an ogre mage who is bothered by faerie dragons: apparently, they are attracted to the green-skinned spellweaver's magical power. If I can find and dispose of them, the ogre will be grateful.
map.h5allin:4.quest.31.42.0.nextVisit: As long as the dragons are alive, there will be no reward.
map.h5allin:4.quest.38.3.0.completed: The crone seemed delighted with the new pot. As a reward, she offered me a potion that she said would strengthen my body. I took a sip from the flask and felt incredibly light—as if my bones and flesh were no longer weighing me down! Should I finish the concoction?
map.h5allin:4.quest.38.3.0.firstVisit: An old woman lives here, completely crazy by the looks of her. She complains about having lost her favorite pot she cooked fish soup in. She begs me to find it, or at least something similar enough. I think I have an idea what I can offer her!
map.h5allin:4.quest.38.3.0.nextVisit: I have nothing for the barmy old woman.
map.h5allin:4.quest.4.65.0.completed: It is done, my Lord Dargem! Would you like to go on board?
map.h5allin:4.quest.4.65.0.firstVisit: Unfortunately, it should take no less than a week and a half to repair the ship.
map.h5allin:4.quest.4.65.0.nextVisit: My Lord, the repairs aren't finished yet!
map.h5allin:4.quest.46.66.0.completed: The ogre is very happy about the return of his ring. In return for it, he offers an unusual-looking piece of paper he fished out of the sea.
map.h5allin:4.quest.46.66.0.firstVisit: An ogre living here complains that some green midgets stole his favorite ring, which helped him run faster than anyone in his tribe. Green midgets?.. Goblins?
map.h5allin:4.quest.46.66.0.nextVisit: While the ring is not here, the ogre does not want to talk.
map.h5allin:4.quest.54.47.0.completed: "Worthy one! Give us the bird medal, and step into our halls."
map.h5allin:4.quest.54.47.0.firstVisit: "If you want to fight us, you must be worthy! Anyone who's worthy has a medal with a bird on it. Do you have one?"
map.h5allin:4.quest.54.47.0.nextVisit: "Our custom says that one who's worthy comes with a medal! Where's the medal?"
map.h5allin:4.quest.64.36.0.completed: Barriers are no obstacle to Dargem Llywellyn! I held the Orb of Inhibition up to the magic wall, and it trembled. Destroy it?
map.h5allin:4.quest.64.36.0.firstVisit: Some kind of a magic barrier again... After studying it, I came to the conclusion I should be able to dispel it with an artifact like the Orb of Inhibition.
map.h5allin:4.quest.64.36.0.nextVisit: I don't think I can do anything without the Orb.
map.h5allin:4.quest.69.3.0.completed: I finally have all the keys! I'm closer to my triumph than ever. All I have to do is whisper the magic words.
map.h5allin:4.quest.69.3.0.firstVisit: I saw a flat rock. According to Casmetra's notes, the entrance should be here, but where exactly? I felt the smooth surface for a long time, until I found a series of barely noticeable indentations. Apparently, one has to put some keys in them to open the entrance.
map.h5allin:4.quest.69.3.0.nextVisit: I'll need exactly 8 keys—can't get through without them.
map.h5allin:4.sign.25.4.0.message: My sister went berserk and started a civil war. Sir Gallavant
map.h5allin:4.sign.38.39.1.message: Give my regards to Sir Christian!
map.h5allin:4.sign.4.70.0.message: "I had to close my establishment and get out of here! No one needs a tavern in a place like this."
map.h5allin:4.sign.71.66.1.message: Thank you for playing our campaign! Hope you enjoyed it.
map.h5allin:4.town.15.17.0.name: Marteena
map.h5allin:4.town.25.51.0.name: Toothfang
map.h5allin:4.town.63.14.0.name: Void
map.tutorial.event.0.description: Witaj w misji treningowej Heroes of Might and Magic III! Nieważne czy grasz w Heroes po raz pierwszy, czy jesteś już weteranem - jesteś na właściwym miejscu. Aby kontynuować kliknij na znajdujący się poniżej przycisk.
map.tutorial.event.1.description: Jeśli jeszcze tego nie zrobiłeś, powinieneś wydrukować dokument "Heroes III Tutorial.pdf". Znajduje się on w tym samym folderze, co gra. Możesz go także przeczytać wybierając odpowiednią pozycję z Menu Start systemu Windows.
map.tutorial.guards.10.4.0.message: Ojej, to miejsce przyprawia dreszcze, ale nie bez przyczyny - jesteś na Przeklętej Ziemi, podczas bitwy zarówno ty, jak i twój przeciwnik utracicie premie szczęścia i morale. Oczywiście nie chcemy żeby stało się to teraz, dlatego podążymy drogą na wschód w kierunku wodospadu.
map.tutorial.guards.24.17.1.message: Zbliżając się, zauważasz kilka Gnolli pilnujących jakiegoś przedmiotu. Czy chcesz z nimi walczyć? (Podpowiedź: zgódź się, powinieneś z łatwością wygrać).
map.tutorial.guards.8.33.0.message: Przed tobą straszliwe miasto Inferno. Dobrze byłoby wstąpić po drodze do Fabryki Machin Wojennych. Tak, czy inaczej, żeby mieć pewność, że nie będziesz miał kłopotów w czasie tej walki do twojej armii dołączy kilku Archaniołów.
map.tutorial.header.description: Na tej mapie początkujący nauczą się podstaw gry, a weterani będą mogli zapoznać się z nowymi funkcjami.
map.tutorial.header.name: Misja Treningowa
map.tutorial.sign.23.19.1.message: Wiadomości mogą być umieszczane również na tabliczkach. Przed tobą cztery kopalnie. Zajmij je, a później udaj się na południowy zachód.
map.tutorial.town.5.5.0.name: Castellatus
